text.p: Average yields at auctions of three- and six-month treasury bills were unchanged, yields on nine-month bills rose and 12-month yields fell from the last sales in Ukraine, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.
Three-month bills remained at 24.47 percent, six-month stayed at 31.27 percent, nine-month firmed to 34.86 percent from 34.84 percent, and 12-month bills eased to 39.87 percent from 39.89 percent.
The results of Wednesday's three-month discount T-bill
auction, compared with the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 5.00 million UAH 6.00 million UAH
Amount sold 0.46 million UAH 6.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 0.44 million UAH 5.65 million UAH
The central bank sold 4,650 T-bills, the bank's statement
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 17.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared with the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 20.00 million UAH 35.00 million UAH
Amount sold 6.34 million UAH 9.77 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.49 million UAH 8.45 million UAH
The central bank sold 63,441 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 17.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared with the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Actual amount raised 76,940 UAH 1.80 million UAH
The central bank sold 970 T-bills, the bank's statement
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is April 17.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared with the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 22.00 million UAH 35.00 million UAH
Amount sold 3.99 million UAH 10.33 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.85 million UAH 7.39 million UAH
The central bank sold 39,891 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 17.
